title: Strongest Sorcerer of Today: 4x Upper/Lower Split
desc:
This is a 4-day upper/lower hypertrophy program designed for intermediate lifters who want to build muscle, improve physique balance, and progress consistently without excessive fatigue. The program combines evidence-based hypertrophy principles with bodybuilding-style specialization, emphasizing high training quality, intelligent recovery management, and sustainable progressive overload across a full 10-week block-periodized training cycle.

The split is built around three primary goals:
- Upper and lower chest development
- Leg and glute hypertrophy
- Upper back density with trap and rhomboid emphasis

Training frequency is set at twice per week for both upper and lower body, allowing muscles to receive more frequent high-quality stimulus while managing recovery more effectively than traditional low-frequency bodybuilding splits.

The weekly structure includes:
- Upper A — Upper chest, shoulders, and traps
- Lower A — Quad and glute-focused squat day
- Upper B — Lower chest and upper back density
- Lower B — Glute and posterior-chain-focused hinge day

Exercise selection prioritizes movements with strong stimulus-to-fatigue ratios, stable progression potential, and consistent execution close to failure. Machine, dumbbell, and Smith machine variations are used strategically to reduce unnecessary joint stress and systemic fatigue while maximizing hypertrophy stimulus.

The program is divided into three phases:
- Block 1 — Hypertrophy Accumulation (Weeks 1–4)
Focuses on building work capacity, reinforcing technique, and accumulating high-quality hypertrophy volume through moderate rep ranges and gradually increasing RPEs.

- Deload (Week 5)
Volume and intensity are reduced to dissipate fatigue, improve recovery, and prepare for heavier intensification work.

- Block 2 — Intensification (Weeks 6–8)
Introduces heavier loading, top-set structures, and lower rep ranges on priority lifts to increase mechanical tension and strength expression while maintaining hypertrophy-focused volume.

- Deload (Week 9)
A second recovery phase to restore performance capacity before the final testing week.

- Block 3 — AMRAP Testing (Week 10)
Uses AMRAP sets on key lifts to measure strength progression, work capacity, and hypertrophy carryover without relying on maximal one-rep testing.

This program is designed for lifters who want a structured, recoverable, and specialization-focused hypertrophy system capable of building size, improving aesthetics, and driving long-term progression.

variations.name: default
days: Upper A — Upper Chest + Shoulders + Traps
Upper B — Lower Chest + Back Density

ex.note: 30° bench. Elbows 45° from torso. 2s down, 1s stretch, drive up. PRIORITY — upper chest. SUB: Smith Incline Press (30°) or Incline Machine Press.
Bar at clavicle. Press up & slightly back. 1s pause at shoulder, no momentum. PRIORITY — front delts. SUB: Seated DB Shoulder Press or Machine Shoulder Press.
Cables HIGH. Soft fixed elbow. Arc down, cross at belly button. Hard squeeze at the bottom. SUB: Pec Deck (lean forward slightly to bias upper chest) or Incline DB Fly.
Arms straight throughout. Shrug UP, 1-2s PAUSE at top. No rolling. PRIORITY — trap hero. SUB: Heavy DB Shrug or Trap Bar Shrug. Cable shrug if heavy unavailable.
Cable LOW, opposite hand. Lead with elbow, pinky high. 3s eccentric — work the negative. SUB: DB Lateral Raise (lean away slightly) or Machine Lateral Raise.
Cable at chest height. Elbows HIGH & OUT. External rotate at end. Light weight, perfect form. SUB: Reverse Pec Deck or Band Pull-Apart (high reps).
Full overhead stretch. Elbows point UP, don't flare. 2s down (deep stretch), drive up. SUB: Seated DB Overhead Extension or EZ-Bar French Press.
Rope, elbows pinned to ribs. Split hands at bottom, 1s squeeze. Last set: optional drop set. SUB: Straight-Bar Pressdown or Machine Dip (tricep-focused, upright torso).
Feet shoulder-width, slightly low. Full depth, knees track over toes. Drive midfoot. PRIORITY. SUB: Pendulum Squat or Smith Squat (front-foot forward). Belt Squat if available.
Bench at lower scapula. Knees 90° at top. Ribs DOWN, 1s glute squeeze at lockout. PRIORITY. SUB: Smith Machine Hip Thrust or Hip Thrust Machine. B-Stance DB Hip Thrust as last resort.
Feet LOW, narrow stance. Deep ROM, drive through balls of feet. Don't lock out. Quad focus. SUB: Hack Squat (close stance) or Pendulum Squat. Sissy Squat for pure quad.
Rear foot elevated 12-18". Drop straight down, drive front foot. Torso forward = glute bias. SUB: Smith Bulgarian Split Squat (more stability) or Walking DB Lunges.
Lean slightly forward. Hard squeeze at top, 1s pause. 3s eccentric. Last set: drop set (~40%). SUB: Sissy Squat (slow tempo) or Reverse Nordic Curl.
Full ROM, heels drop low. 1-2s STRETCH at bottom — that's the growth driver. Knee straight = gastroc. SUB: Smith Calf Raise (heels on plate) or Leg Press Calf Raise (knees nearly straight).
Kneel, rope behind head. FLEX SPINE — pull elbows to thighs. Hips DON'T move. Round upper back. SUB: Machine Crunch or Decline Weighted Crunch (plate on chest).
15-20° bench (sternal pec bias). Elbows 45°. 2-3s down, drive up. PRIORITY — lower chest. SUB: Flat DB Press or Smith Flat Press (slight forward lean for lower chest bias).
Pronated grip, 1.5x shoulder width. Dead hang at bottom, chest to bar. PRIORITY — sub pulldown if needed. SUB: Lat Pulldown (pronated, 1.5x grip) or Assisted Pull-Up Machine. Match weighted load.
Lean forward 15-20° (more lean = more chest). Elbows tucked 45°. Below parallel. PRIORITY — lower chest hero. SUB: Chest Dip Machine (forward lean) or Decline Smith Press.

Chest pad locked. Full stretch at bottom, hard squeeze at top. 3s eccentric. PRIORITY — rhomboids. No body english. SUB: Chest-Supported Machine Row (neutral grip) or Seal Row. NOT regular bent row — defeats the point.
Cables LOW. Arc UP across body, meet HIGH at chest. 2s stretch, 1s squeeze. Lower chest isolation. SUB: Low-to-High DB Fly (flat bench, arc upward) or Pec Deck.
D-handle, kneel. Pull elbow DOWN & BACK to hip. Full stretch at top, lean away at peak. 3s eccentric. SUB: Machine Pullover (best — preserves lat stretch) or Cable Pullover (rope, kneeling).
Cable at chest, opposite hand grip. Pull across to rear, lead with elbow. Hard squeeze. Light weight. SUB: Reverse Pec Deck or Bent-Over DB Reverse Fly (chest-supported on incline bench).
Low pulley. Step FORWARD so arms hang BEHIND hips at start. Don't let elbows drift. Long head emphasis. SUB: Incline DB Curl (lying back, arms hanging — stretches long head) or Bayesian Cable Curl.
DBs at sides, neutral grip. Curl 'out, not up' — slightly across body. 3s eccentric. Brachialis/forearm. SUB: Rope Hammer Curl (low pulley) or Cross-Body DB Hammer Curl.

Bar at hip crease. Soft FIXED knees — hinge, don't squat. Push hips BACK, deep ham stretch. 3s eccentric. PRIORITY. SUB: DB RDL (grip-limited but cleaner path) or Smith RDL. Trap Bar RDL if available.

Lighter than Day 2. 2s pause at top, focus on SQUEEZE not load. Last set: 1.5 reps. Metabolic stimulus. SUB: Smith Machine Hip Thrust (lighter) or Hip Thrust Machine. High-rep Glute Bridge if no setup.
Lap pad snug. Stretched-position ham work (long head). 3-4s eccentric — slowest part. Best ham exercise. SUB: Lying Leg Curl (shorter ROM but solid) or Nordic Curl (eccentric only, brutal).
Feet HIGH, slight toe-out. Deep ROM, knees toward armpits. Don't tuck lower back. Glute bias. SUB: Smith B-Stance RDL or Single-Leg Press (high foot).

Hip crease past pad, feet out. Round upper back, tuck chin, squeeze glutes up. Stop at neutral. Reverse hyper alt. SUB: Reverse Hyper (if you have access) or Glute-Ham Raise machine. Cable Pull-Through as last resort.
Lean forward 30° for glute medius (upper glute shelf). Drive knees out, 1s squeeze. Slow eccentric. SUB: Cable Hip Abduction (single-leg, ankle strap) or Banded Side-Step.
Full stretch at bottom. Squeeze knees together, 1s hold midline. Supports glutes/hams indirectly. SUB: Cable Hip Adduction (ankle strap) or Copenhagen Plank.

Pad on lower quads. Same stretch focus as standing. Knee bent = SOLEUS. Different fiber type — needed. SUB: Tibialis-anterior unavailable here — no substitute. Skip if machine taken (gastroc covers most growth).

[Keep light] Cable LOW, opposite hand. Lead with elbow, pinky high. 3s eccentric — work the negative. SUB: DB Lateral Raise (lean away slightly) or Machine Lateral Raise.
[Keep light] Cable at chest height. Elbows HIGH & OUT. External rotate at end. Light weight, perfect form. SUB: Reverse Pec Deck or Band Pull-Apart (high reps).
[Keep light] Full overhead stretch. Elbows point UP, don't flare. 2s down (deep stretch), drive up. SUB: Seated DB Overhead Extension or EZ-Bar French Press.
[Keep light] Rope, elbows pinned to ribs. Split hands at bottom, 1s squeeze. Last set: optional drop set. SUB: Straight-Bar Pressdown or Machine Dip (tricep-focused, upright torso).

[AMRAP @ 90% — SPOTTER on press lifts] Feet shoulder-width, slightly low. Full depth, knees track over toes. Drive midfoot. PRIORITY. SUB: Pendulum Squat or Smith Squat (front-foot forward). Belt Squat if available.

[AMRAP @ 90% — SPOTTER on press lifts] Bench at lower scapula. Knees 90° at top. Ribs DOWN, 1s glute squeeze at lockout. PRIORITY. SUB: Smith Machine Hip Thrust or Hip Thrust Machine. B-Stance DB Hip Thrust as last resort.
[Keep light] Feet LOW, narrow stance. Deep ROM, drive through balls of feet. Don't lock out. Quad focus. SUB: Hack Squat (close stance) or Pendulum Squat. Sissy Squat for pure quad.
[Keep light] Rear foot elevated 12-18". Drop straight down, drive front foot. Torso forward = glute bias. SUB: Smith Bulgarian Split Squat (more stability) or Walking DB Lunges.
[Keep light] Lean slightly forward. Hard squeeze at top, 1s pause. 3s eccentric. Last set: drop set (~40%). SUB: Sissy Squat (slow tempo) or Reverse Nordic Curl.

[Keep light] Full ROM, heels drop low. 1-2s STRETCH at bottom — that's the growth driver. Knee straight = gastroc. SUB: Smith Calf Raise (heels on plate) or Leg Press Calf Raise (knees nearly straight).
[Keep light] Kneel, rope behind head. FLEX SPINE — pull elbows to thighs. Hips DON'T move. Round upper back. SUB: Machine Crunch or Decline Weighted Crunch (plate on chest).

[AMRAP @ 90% — SPOTTER on press lifts] 15-20° bench (sternal pec bias). Elbows 45°. 2-3s down, drive up. PRIORITY — lower chest. SUB: Flat DB Press or Smith Flat Press (slight forward lean for lower chest bias).

[Keep light] Pronated grip, 1.5x shoulder width. Dead hang at bottom, chest to bar. PRIORITY — sub pulldown if needed. SUB: Lat Pulldown (pronated, 1.5x grip) or Assisted Pull-Up Machine. Match weighted load.
[Keep light] Lean forward 15-20° (more lean = more chest). Elbows tucked 45°. Below parallel. PRIORITY — lower chest hero. SUB: Chest Dip Machine (forward lean) or Decline Smith Press.

[Keep light] Chest pad locked. Full stretch at bottom, hard squeeze at top. 3s eccentric. PRIORITY — rhomboids. No body english. SUB: Chest-Supported Machine Row (neutral grip) or Seal Row. NOT regular bent row — defeats the point.
[Keep light] Cables LOW. Arc UP across body, meet HIGH at chest. 2s stretch, 1s squeeze. Lower chest isolation. SUB: Low-to-High DB Fly (flat bench, arc upward) or Pec Deck.

[Keep light] D-handle, kneel. Pull elbow DOWN & BACK to hip. Full stretch at top, lean away at peak. 3s eccentric. SUB: Machine Pullover (best — preserves lat stretch) or Cable Pullover (rope, kneeling).

[Keep light] Cable at chest, opposite hand grip. Pull across to rear, lead with elbow. Hard squeeze. Light weight. SUB: Reverse Pec Deck or Bent-Over DB Reverse Fly (chest-supported on incline bench).

[Keep light] Low pulley. Step FORWARD so arms hang BEHIND hips at start. Don't let elbows drift. Long head emphasis. SUB: Incline DB Curl (lying back, arms hanging — stretches long head) or Bayesian Cable Curl.
[Keep light] DBs at sides, neutral grip. Curl 'out, not up' — slightly across body. 3s eccentric. Brachialis/forearm. SUB: Rope Hammer Curl (low pulley) or Cross-Body DB Hammer Curl.

[Keep light] Bar at hip crease. Soft FIXED knees — hinge, don't squat. Push hips BACK, deep ham stretch. 3s eccentric. PRIORITY. SUB: DB RDL (grip-limited but cleaner path) or Smith RDL. Trap Bar RDL if available.

[Keep light] Lighter than Day 2. 2s pause at top, focus on SQUEEZE not load. Last set: 1.5 reps. Metabolic stimulus. SUB: Smith Machine Hip Thrust (lighter) or Hip Thrust Machine. High-rep Glute Bridge if no setup.

[Keep light] Lap pad snug. Stretched-position ham work (long head). 3-4s eccentric — slowest part. Best ham exercise. SUB: Lying Leg Curl (shorter ROM but solid) or Nordic Curl (eccentric only, brutal).
[Keep light] Feet HIGH, slight toe-out. Deep ROM, knees toward armpits. Don't tuck lower back. Glute bias. SUB: Smith B-Stance RDL or Single-Leg Press (high foot).

[Keep light] Hip crease past pad, feet out. Round upper back, tuck chin, squeeze glutes up. Stop at neutral. Reverse hyper alt. SUB: Reverse Hyper (if you have access) or Glute-Ham Raise machine. Cable Pull-Through as last resort.
[Keep light] Lean forward 30° for glute medius (upper glute shelf). Drive knees out, 1s squeeze. Slow eccentric. SUB: Cable Hip Abduction (single-leg, ankle strap) or Banded Side-Step.
[Keep light] Full stretch at bottom. Squeeze knees together, 1s hold midline. Supports glutes/hams indirectly. SUB: Cable Hip Adduction (ankle strap) or Copenhagen Plank.

[Keep light] Pad on lower quads. Same stretch focus as standing. Knee bent = SOLEUS. Different fiber type — needed. SUB: Tibialis-anterior unavailable here — no substitute. Skip if machine taken (gastroc covers most growth).
